study.title: A Phase 3, Randomized Study of Dual Immunotherapy in Advanced NSCLC
study.headline: Forecast DBL delay: 6 days. Driven primarily by safety reconciliation (35%), delayed central laboratory transfer (30%), and ageing critical queries (22%).

primaryDrivers.summary: 2 unresolved SAE discrepancies at Site 104 blocking pharmacovigilance safety freeze.
Batch #LXB-8921 (ctDNA panel) checksum failure awaiting vendor QA re-export.
14 critical queries aged >14 days affecting RECIST tumor restaging at Sites 104 & 317.
18 case report books completed but awaiting PI electronic signatures.

dimensions.name: Safety Reconciliation
dimensions.details: 2 SAE discordances between Rave EDC and Argus Safety. 1 death narrative unconfirmed.

dimensions.name: External Data Readiness
dimensions.details: LabCorp ctDNA batch #LXB-8921 failed MD5 hash. Eurofins chemistry batch in QA review.

dimensions.name: Query Resolution
dimensions.details: 68 total open queries. 14 critical queries aged >14 days on primary efficacy forms.

dimensions.name: SDV / SDR & Sign-offs
dimensions.details: SDV 93% complete. 18 PI sign-offs remaining at Sites 104, 317 and 405.

dimensions.name: Medical Coding
dimensions.details: MedDRA 27.0 and WHODrug Global C3 dictionary auto-coding running at 97.4%. 12 terms pending manual coder review.

dimensions.name: EDC Completeness
dimensions.details: 94% visits entered within 5 days SLA. 12 non-critical eCRF forms pending data entry.

actions.title: Resolve 2 SAE discrepancies at Site 104
actions.rationale: Unresolved SAE discrepancies blocking safety database freeze, a prerequisite for DBL.
actions.proposedPlan: Conduct urgent ad-hoc safety review call with Boston Medical Center PI and safety monitor.
actions.recommendation: Resolve 2 unresolved SAE discrepancies that are affecting pharmacovigilance safety freeze and are on the critical DBL path.
actions.proposedCommunication: Draft email to Safety team and site with list of outstanding items.

actions.title: Escalate overdue LabCorp ctDNA transfer (#LXB-8921)
actions.rationale: ctDNA panel batch failed MD5 checksum verification; central lab transfer is 4 days overdue.
actions.proposedPlan: Trigger Vendor SLA escalation protocol; obtain re-exported binary batch with QA certificate.
actions.recommendation: Escalate overdue central laboratory transfer with LabCorp project management for expedited QA re-transmission.
actions.proposedCommunication: Vendor SLA formal escalation notice to LabCorp Account Executive.

actions.title: Prioritise 5 ageing RECIST primary endpoint queries
actions.action: Prioritise 5 ageing RECIST primary endpoint queries
actions.rationale: Queries affect tumor restaging measurements for PFS primary endpoint analysis.
actions.proposedPlan: Arrange dedicated remote query-resolution sprint with the site study coordinator.
actions.recommendation: Schedule a 2-hour focused working session with Charité imaging sub-investigator.
actions.affectedItems: 5 critical queries on RECIST Target Lesions
actions.proposedCommunication: Direct message to Study Coordinator and CRA.

actions.title: Execute targeted CRA strike team at Site 208
actions.rationale: Site 208 has 41 routine queries accumulating without response for >21 days.
actions.proposedPlan: Deploy traveling CRA monitor to assist site data coordinator on-site for 2 business days.
actions.recommendation: Deploy on-site assistance to clear non-critical backlog before LSLV cut-off.
actions.proposedCommunication: Travel authorization and site visit letter.

actions.title: Complete medical coding review for pivotal cohort
actions.rationale: 38 uncoded concomitant medications and adverse events awaiting Medical Reviewer sign-off.
actions.proposedPlan: Run batch auto-encoder match and submit 12 manual verbatim terms for medical review.
actions.recommendation: Complete medical coding review for all closed subjects.

actions.title: Obtain investigator sign-offs across high-volume sites
actions.rationale: 18 completed case report books awaiting PI electronic signatures.
actions.proposedPlan: Send weekly batch signing links and schedule telephone follow-ups with PIs.
actions.recommendation: Escalate pending PI signatures for Seoul (405) and Boston (104).

actions.title: Review eCOA data completeness and compliance
actions.rationale: Handheld patient devices showing 76% weekly compliance against 85% protocol target.
actions.proposedPlan: Trigger automated SMS prompts to remaining active subjects.

actions.title: Monitor query ageing trend across European sites
actions.rationale: Ensure newly issued queries are addressed within 5 business day SLA.
actions.proposedPlan: Track velocity metric during bi-weekly clinical ops status call.
actions.recommendation: Keep regular weekly monitoring in place.

actions.title: Accelerate central imaging adjudication batch #IMG-44
actions.rationale: Independent central radiology review (ICR) discordant pair awaiting third tie-breaker adjudication.
actions.proposedPlan: Schedule urgent tie-breaker session with Dr. Thorne.
actions.recommendation: Lock imaging read before clinical database freeze.
actions.proposedCommunication: Priority adjudication request to ICR chair.

actions.title: Resolve safety death narrative discordance (Subj 104-012)
actions.rationale: Cause of death listed as Disease Progression in EDC but Sepsis/Septic Shock in Argus Safety.
actions.proposedPlan: Obtain hospital discharge summary to establish definitive consensus for PV filing.
actions.recommendation: Align primary cause of death prior to unblinding and safety freeze.
actions.proposedCommunication: Urgent medical clarification request to Investigator.

actions.title: Clear freeze-blocking safety discrepancy at Site 208
actions.rationale: Suspected unexpected serious adverse reaction (SUSAR) onset date discrepancy of 4 days.
actions.proposedPlan: Review source triage document with pharmacovigilance specialist.
actions.recommendation: Reconcile date of onset to unfreeze safety database.

actions.title: Conduct PI batch sign-off session at Seoul Hospital

actions.proposedPlan: Provide direct technical assistance to Sub-I to complete electronic signatures.
actions.proposedCommunication: Meeting invite with step-by-step PDF guide.

forecastScenarios.assumptions: Critical interventions (SAE recon + LabCorp transfer) executed within 48 hours. Zero new SAE reports emerging post-LSLV. Query closure velocity hits 4.2/day across all sites.
Current team velocity continues. SAE discrepancy resolved by Nov 03. LabCorp transfer ingested Nov 02. Minor routine queries burn down within 7 days.
Site 104 PI unavailable during Thanksgiving week. Vendor transfer fails second checksum verification. Secondary RECIST adjudication requires scan repeat.
